annotations.title: Reply to a ticket as an agent

description: Add an agent reply to a ticket and/or change its status, priority, assignee, due date or tags. The contact is emailed ONLY if update_customer is true (HappyFox default: false). With no message it just updates properties. Moving to a completed status may require the category's compulsory custom fields. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/staff_update/.

assignee.description: Agent id to assign the ticket to (from happyfox_list_staff); null to unassign.

bcc.description: BCC email addresses, as a comma-separated string.

cc.description: CC email addresses, as a comma-separated string.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed "t-cf-<id>". Ticket fields (ids from happyfox_list_ticket_custom_fields); compulsory-on-completion fields are required when closing. Values: text = string, number = number, dropdown = choice id, multiple choice = array of choice ids, date = yyyy-mm-dd.

staff.description: The agent making the reply (happyfox_list_staff) id.

subject.description: Override the subject of the email sent to the contact.

tags.description: Tags to set, as a comma-separated string.

ticket_number.description: The ticket NUMBER (the `id` field, e.g. 3 for #DC00000003) — not the prefixed display id.

time_spent.description: Minutes to add to the ticket's time spent (some categories require it).

update_customer.description: true = send the reply to the contact by email. Default false.

name: happyfox_add_staff_reply
title: Reply to a ticket as an agent
